say:1:1621509001:1.source_cn: 刚才的演讲——你听得怎么样？有没有被我的气场震撼到？

choice_prompt:2:1621509001.source_cn: 刚才的演讲——你听得怎么样？有没有被我的气场震撼到？

say:3:1621509002:1.text: Meow! I knew you had good taste!
say:3:1621509002:1.source_cn: 喵哼哼~我就知道，你这种有眼光的动物一定会懂得欣赏。
say:3:1621509002:1.male: Meow! I knew you had good taste!
say:3:1621509002:1.female: Meow! I knew you had good taste!

say:4:1621509003:1.text: The hardest part is bringing my vision to life, you know.
say:4:1621509003:1.source_cn: 不过……听得懂是一回事，能做到是另一回事。
say:4:1621509003:1.male: The hardest part is bringing my vision to life, you know.
say:4:1621509003:1.female: The hardest part is bringing my vision to life, you know.

say:5:1621509009:1.text: By the way, you did a good job finding me, given how carefully I conceal my tracks and scent.
say:5:1621509009:1.source_cn: 不过，我有消除自己踪迹和气味的习惯，但还是被你找到，说...
say:5:1621509009:1.male: By the way, you did a good job finding me, given how carefully I conceal my tracks and scent.
say:5:1621509009:1.female: By the way, you did a good job finding me, given how carefully I conceal my tracks and scent.

say:6:1621509010:1.text: I think you might be able to help me with something. The future of the entire animal kingdom is at stake!
say:6:1621509010:1.source_cn: 我有件事需要你的帮忙，一件关系到整个动物界未来的……大事！
say:6:1621509010:1.male: I think you might be able to help me with something. The future of the entire animal kingdom is at stake!
say:6:1621509010:1.female: I think you might be able to help me with something. The future of the entire animal kingdom is at stake!

say:7:1621509011:1.text: The book I lost is called <style="highlight">"Magic for Babies,"</style> authored by the great Magister Merlin. If I can fully master the spells inside, I'll gain unparalleled power.
say:7:1621509011:1.male: The book I lost is called <style="highlight">"Magic for Babies,"</style> authored by the great Magister Merlin. If I can fully master the spells inside, I'll gain unparalleled power.
say:7:1621509011:1.female: The book I lost is called <style="highlight">"Magic for Babies,"</style> authored by the great Magister Merlin. If I can fully master the spells inside, I'll gain unparalleled power.

say:8:1621509012:1.text: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin himself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!
say:8:1621509012:1.source_cn: 喵哈哈哈……到时候就算是梅林亲自站在我面前，也得俯首称臣！
say:8:1621509012:1.male: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin himself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!
say:8:1621509012:1.female: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin herself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!

choice_prompt:9:1621509012.text: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin himself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!
choice_prompt:9:1621509012.source_cn: 喵哈哈哈……到时候就算是梅林亲自站在我面前，也得俯首称臣！
choice_prompt:9:1621509012.male: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin himself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!
choice_prompt:9:1621509012.female: I'll probably get so good that even Merlin herself has to wave the white flag! Meowhaha!

say:10:1621509013:1.text: No doubt about it! To be exact, Merlin wrote it just for me.
say:10:1621509013:1.source_cn: 哼，那当然！确切地说这是梅林专门写给我的书。
say:10:1621509013:1.male: No doubt about it! To be exact, Merlin wrote it just for me.
say:10:1621509013:1.female: No doubt about it! To be exact, Merlin wrote it just for me.

say:11:1621509014:1.text: It's addressed to the "future genius," which, obviously, means me.
say:11:1621509014:1.source_cn: 第一页上就写着“致未来的天才”，那不就是在说我吗？
say:11:1621509014:1.male: It's addressed to the "future genius," which, obviously, means me.
say:11:1621509014:1.female: It's addressed to the "future genius," which, obviously, means me.

say:12:1621509020:1.text: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...
say:12:1621509020:1.source_cn: 反之……如果没有那本书，我的伟大计划可就要延缓了。
say:12:1621509020:1.male: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...
say:12:1621509020:1.female: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...

choice_prompt:13:1621509020.text: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...
choice_prompt:13:1621509020.source_cn: 反之……如果没有那本书，我的伟大计划可就要延缓了。
choice_prompt:13:1621509020.male: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...
choice_prompt:13:1621509020.female: But without it, my grand plan will have to wait...

say:14:1621509021:1.text: I hope you're not about to lecture me on morality. That's what those dumb dogs would do.
say:14:1621509021:1.source_cn: 你不会想给我上一堂“道德课”吧？别学那些脏兮兮的蠢狗。
say:14:1621509021:1.male: I hope you're not about to lecture me on morality. That's what those dumb dogs would do.
say:14:1621509021:1.female: I hope you're not about to lecture me on morality. That's what those dumb dogs would do.

say:15:1621509022:1.text: In the world of cats, the concept of stealing doesn't exist.
say:15:1621509022:1.source_cn: 猫咪的字典里，可从来就不存在偷这个字。
say:15:1621509022:1.male: In the world of cats, the concept of stealing doesn't exist.
say:15:1621509022:1.female: In the world of cats, the concept of stealing doesn't exist.

say:16:1621509023:0.text: I simply call it "strategic resource allocation."
say:16:1621509023:0.source_cn: 格局放宽，领袖自然不会干那种勾当，这叫合理调度资源！
say:16:1621509023:0.male: I simply call it "strategic resource allocation."
say:16:1621509023:0.female: I simply call it "strategic resource allocation."

say:17:1621509024:1.text: Yes! I'm not just after the Serene Lyceum, but the entire Esperia as well! Meowhaha...
say:17:1621509024:1.source_cn: 当然！我的计划可不止莱希拉姆，是整个伊索米亚！喵哈哈哈……
say:17:1621509024:1.male: Yes! I'm not just after the Serene Lyceum, but the entire Esperia as well! Meowhaha...
say:17:1621509024:1.female: Yes! I'm not just after the Serene Lyceum, but the entire Esperia as well! Meowhaha...

say:18:1621509025:1.text: I won't rely on sheer brute force to achieve that. My wisdom and charisma are just as powerful.
say:18:1621509025:1.source_cn: 不过，征服不只是强力，还要有智慧和魅力，懂了吗？
say:18:1621509025:1.male: I won't rely on sheer brute force to achieve that. My wisdom and charisma are just as powerful.
say:18:1621509025:1.female: I won't rely on sheer brute force to achieve that. My wisdom and charisma are just as powerful.

choice:13:1:2.text: Do you aim to conquer the world?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 你所说的伟大计划是征服？
choice:13:1:2.male: Do you aim to conquer the world?
choice:13:1:2.female: Do you aim to conquer the world?

say:19:1621509026:1.text: Oh, please. I did keep it somewhere safe.
say:19:1621509026:1.source_cn: 嘁，这可是秘密武器，怎么会轻易丢呢？
say:19:1621509026:1.male: Oh, please. I did keep it somewhere safe.
say:19:1621509026:1.female: Oh, please. I did keep it somewhere safe.

say:20:1621509027:1.text: I'm sure my haters took it. Cheap tricks are all they've got to slow me down.
say:20:1621509027:1.source_cn: 一定是那些反对者干的，只能做这种勾当来阻止我。
say:20:1621509027:1.male: I'm sure my haters took it. Cheap tricks are all they've got to slow me down.
say:20:1621509027:1.female: I'm sure my haters took it. Cheap tricks are all they've got to slow me down.

choice:13:2:3.text: How could you misplace the book?
choice:13:2:3.source_cn: 这么重要的东西为什么丢了
choice:13:2:3.male: How could you misplace the book?
choice:13:2:3.female: How could you misplace the book?

say:21:1621509028:1.text: No doubt! Once that book returns to me, I'll have the world at my feet!
say:21:1621509028:1.source_cn: 当然！只要拿回那本魔法书，天下就唾手可得了！
say:21:1621509028:1.male: No doubt! Once that book returns to me, I'll have the world at my feet!
say:21:1621509028:1.female: No doubt! Once that book returns to me, I'll have the world at my feet!

say:22:1621509029:1.text: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.
say:22:1621509029:1.source_cn: 是时候展现你的忠诚了，上路吧。
say:22:1621509029:1.male: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.
say:22:1621509029:1.female: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.

choice_prompt:23:1621509029.text: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.
choice_prompt:23:1621509029.source_cn: 是时候展现你的忠诚了，上路吧。
choice_prompt:23:1621509029.male: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.
choice_prompt:23:1621509029.female: Now, prove where your loyalty lies and bring it back to me.

say:24:1621509030:1.text: Think about it—once I rule the world, you can have all the treats you want and nap on three royal-grade cushions stacked together.
say:24:1621509030:1.source_cn: 想想看，只要我当上了世界之王，宠物零食随你挑，皇家午睡...
say:24:1621509030:1.male: Think about it—once I rule the world, you can have all the treats you want and nap on three royal-grade cushions stacked together.
say:24:1621509030:1.female: Think about it—once I rule the world, you can have all the treats you want and nap on three royal-grade cushions stacked together.

say:25:1621509031:1.text: Best of all, you'll have cat servants giving you massages every day!
say:25:1621509031:1.source_cn: 还有贴心小猫咪每天给你捏肩捶背，喵！
say:25:1621509031:1.male: Best of all, you'll have cat servants giving you massages every day!
say:25:1621509031:1.female: Best of all, you'll have cat servants giving you massages every day!

say:26:1621509032:1.text: But you need to prove yourself first. Quit dawdling and get going.
say:26:1621509032:1.source_cn: 当然，你得配得上这个待遇才行，别磨蹭了，快去吧。
say:26:1621509032:1.male: But you need to prove yourself first. Quit dawdling and get going.
say:26:1621509032:1.female: But you need to prove yourself first. Quit dawdling and get going.

say:27:1621509037:1.text: Oh, and I hope you don't get physical with those haters. They're just a bunch of fools desperate to please the humans, and I'm not the type to bully the weak.
say:27:1621509037:1.source_cn: 不过我有个小小的要求，不要伤害那群反对者，说到底那不过...
say:27:1621509037:1.male: Oh, and I hope you don't get physical with those haters. They're just a bunch of fools desperate to please the humans, and I'm not the type to bully the weak.
say:27:1621509037:1.female: Oh, and I hope you don't get physical with those haters. They're just a bunch of fools desperate to please the humans, and I'm not the type to bully the weak.

say:28:1621509038:1.text: This bookmark came from the book, and it still holds a trace of its scent.
say:28:1621509038:1.source_cn: 这是那本魔法书的书签，上面有残留的气味。
say:28:1621509038:1.male: This bookmark came from the book, and it still holds a trace of its scent.
say:28:1621509038:1.female: This bookmark came from the book, and it still holds a trace of its scent.

say:29:1621509039:1.source_cn: 快去快回，我等你的消息。

choice:23:0:1.text: Did I offer to help you?
choice:23:0:1.male: Did I offer to help you?
choice:23:0:1.female: Did I offer to help you?

say:31:1621509033:1.text: Excellent. Those who remain loyal to me will be handsomely rewarded.
say:31:1621509033:1.source_cn: 很好，非常好。我绝不会亏待任何一个忠诚的部下。
say:31:1621509033:1.male: Excellent. Those who remain loyal to me will be handsomely rewarded.
say:31:1621509033:1.female: Excellent. Those who remain loyal to me will be handsomely rewarded.

say:32:1621509034:1.text: Get this done, and you'll become my right-hand man.
say:32:1621509034:1.source_cn: 这件事办妥，你就是头号功臣。
say:32:1621509034:1.male: Get this done, and you'll become my right-hand man.
say:32:1621509034:1.female: Get this done, and you'll become my right-hand man.

say:34:1621509036:1.text: Very well, let's see how far your best effort can take you. Don't let me down, meow!
say:34:1621509036:1.source_cn: 也罢，我就看看，你的尽力能做到哪一步。别让我失望喵~
say:34:1621509036:1.male: Very well, let's see how far your best effort can take you. Don't let me down, meow!
say:34:1621509036:1.female: Very well, let's see how far your best effort can take you. Don't let me down, meow!

choice:13:3:4.text: You sure the book brings power?
choice:13:3:4.source_cn: 你就这么确定书能带来力量？
choice:13:3:4.male: You sure the book brings power?
choice:13:3:4.female: You sure the book brings power?

choice:9:0:1.text: Are you sure Merlin wrote it?
choice:9:0:1.male: Are you sure Merlin wrote it?
choice:9:0:1.female: Are you sure Merlin wrote it?

say:35:1621509015:1.text: Hmph, I don't care one bit about what Merlin likes!
say:35:1621509015:1.source_cn: 哼，梅林喜欢什么我才不关心呢！
say:35:1621509015:1.male: Hmph, I don't care one bit about what Merlin likes!
say:35:1621509015:1.female: Hmph, I don't care one bit about what Merlin likes!

say:36:1621509016:1.text: It's fortunate he's fond of cats, for that alone earns him my mercy.
say:36:1621509016:1.source_cn: 不喜欢猫，我就会惩罚<male>他</male><fe...
say:36:1621509016:1.male: It's fortunate he's fond of cats, for that alone earns him my mercy.
say:36:1621509016:1.female: It's fortunate she's fond of cats, for that alone earns her my mercy.

say:37:1621509017:1.text: Invincible? You must've been brainwashed by those magic textbooks.
say:37:1621509017:1.source_cn: 不可战胜？你是不是也被那堆魔法教材洗脑了？
say:37:1621509017:1.male: Invincible? You must've been brainwashed by those magic textbooks.
say:37:1621509017:1.female: Invincible? You must've been brainwashed by those magic textbooks.

say:38:1621509018:1.text: If he can pull it off, so can I, and I'll do it better!
say:38:1621509018:1.male: If he can pull it off, so can I, and I'll do it better!
say:38:1621509018:1.female: If she can pull it off, so can I, and I'll do it better!

say:39:1621509019:1.text: Once I crack the secrets of this book, I'll take his place as the new legend!
say:39:1621509019:1.source_cn: 等我掌握了这本书的秘密，<male>他</male><...
say:39:1621509019:1.male: Once I crack the secrets of this book, I'll take his place as the new legend!
say:39:1621509019:1.female: Once I crack the secrets of this book, I'll take her place as the new legend!

say:40:1621509004:1.text: Oh? You probably haven't grasped the point yet.
say:40:1621509004:1.male: Oh? You probably haven't grasped the point yet.
say:40:1621509004:1.female: Oh? You probably haven't grasped the point yet.

say:41:1621509005:1.text: Great things take time to digest.
say:41:1621509005:1.source_cn: 伟大的东西，总是要时间来理解的，我不怪你。
say:41:1621509005:1.male: Great things take time to digest.
say:41:1621509005:1.female: Great things take time to digest.

say:42:1621509006:1.text: Tsk, can't believe you let your mind wander while I was speaking.
say:42:1621509006:1.source_cn: 啧，居然能在我的演讲下分神……
say:42:1621509006:1.male: Tsk, can't believe you let your mind wander while I was speaking.
say:42:1621509006:1.female: Tsk, can't believe you let your mind wander while I was speaking.

say:43:1621509007:1.text: I'm sorry to say you've missed a historic moment.
say:43:1621509007:1.source_cn: 你啊，是错过了一场历史时刻。
say:43:1621509007:1.male: I'm sorry to say you've missed a historic moment.
say:43:1621509007:1.female: I'm sorry to say you've missed a historic moment.

say:44:1621509008:1.text: But don't worry, you'll get plenty of chances to hear me speak once I conquer the world!
say:44:1621509008:1.source_cn: 不过也好，等我真正征服世界，再给你一个重新聆听的机会！
say:44:1621509008:1.male: But don't worry, you'll get plenty of chances to hear me speak once I conquer the world!
say:44:1621509008:1.female: But don't worry, you'll get plenty of chances to hear me speak once I conquer the world!
